name: mt-bench-CAAJ
description: A variant of MT-Bench designed to evaluate model outputs (likely focused on multilingual or machine-translation-related behaviors) via head-to-head comparisons or multi-turn evaluation scenarios. It measures model quality on open-ended conversational/translation tasks and/or preference judgments between model responses.
reputation: A community variant of MT-Bench with limited but growing usage among researchers experimenting with multilingual and comparative LLM evaluation.
